# Synthetic report fixture

`quantgt_sample.json` was generated on 2026-10-26 for offline validation, presentation previews and resource measurements. It contains five invented Portfolio rows and ten invented Watchlist rows. Symbols, companies, prices, scores, earnings dates and commentary are synthetic; no production subscription content, email addresses or credentials were copied.

The JSON uses the retained report schema and passes its completeness checks. `_fixture.synthetic` is true, source URLs use `example.invalid`, and `auth_verified` is false. It must never be presented as a live source capture. Add a visible **“Synthetic demo data / 模拟演示数据”** banner when using the rendered report or screenshot outside automated tests.
